facts.what: use 22's platform charge (settle_hold) landed after the same signed bytes were broadcast again
facts.why: the metering writer signed and broadcast settle_hold once (tx 5zvfbriJbyfoAhpk4bovXmT1LDzZUTqt7rteWNLgug7f); the RPC answered nothing usable and every endpoint later reported the transaction unknown, so the app left the charge unknown and sent nothing new, by design. Before the contract's settle deadline the operator broadcast the identical stored signed transaction (same nonce, same hash: it can execute at most once). Its own final status: SuccessValue ["charged"]. The resumed run then read the charge back through the app.
facts.also: the resumed attempts read through https://near-testnet.drpc.org after FastNEAR's free tier answered read_failed
